card.text: The Beehive Cluster is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 183 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2632: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 183.49109237 pc (16th to 84th percentile 183 to 184)

sources.quote: The Beehive Cluster is an open cluster in the constellation Cancer.

introduction.text: The Beehive Cluster is drawn as 793 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
